newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's MOF declines to comment on forex rumours.
newsitem.headline: Japan's MOF declines to comment on forex rumours.

text.p: A Finance Ministry spokesman declined to comment on market rumours circulating in late trade on Friday that the ministry had warned traders not to buy dollars above 119.00 yen.
"In general principle, the ministry won't comment on rumours and movements in the market," the ministry spokesman told Reuters.

The dollar earlier fell on the rumours to around 118.50/60 yen after rising as high as 118.95 yen due to buying by U.S. funds in light of the weakness of the Tokyo stock market and falling Japanese government bond yields.
